categories.main_business_segments: Mondelēz International operates four primary business segments organized by geography: Latin America, AMEA (Asia, Middle East and Africa), Europe, and North America. The company's core business focuses on chocolate, biscuits and baked snacks, with additional adjacent categories including gum & candy, cheese & grocery, and powdered beverages. The company sells products in over 150 countries with approximately 148 manufacturing facilities across 46 countries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs global manufacturing and processing capabilities across 148 facilities in 46 countries, utilizing a distributed network of warehouses and distribution centers. Core production methods include chocolate manufacturing, biscuit and baked snacks production, and processing of adjacent snack categories. The company invests in research and development through 12 global technical centers focused on food safety, quality improvement, new product development, and sustainability innovations including reduced-sugar formulations and plant-based alternatives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Mondelēz serves supermarket chains, wholesalers, supercenters, club stores, mass merchandisers, distributors, convenience stores, gasoline stations, drug stores, value stores, and other retail food outlets. The company also sells directly to consumers through e-retail platforms, retailer digital platforms, direct-to-consumer websites, and social media. No single customer accounted for more than 10% of net revenues in 2022. Primary end markets include chocolate, biscuits & baked snacks, gum & candy, beverages, and cheese & grocery categories across both developed and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in approximately 80 countries and sells products in over 150 countries worldwide. In 2022, 73.6% of net revenues were generated outside the United States. Key regions include North America, Europe, Latin America, and AMEA (Asia, Middle East and Africa). Emerging markets include Latin America in its entirety, AMEA excluding Australia/New Zealand/Japan, and select Eastern European countries. Developed markets include North America, Western Europe, and Australia/New Zealand/Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mondelēz operates across the snacking supply chain as a manufacturer and distributor of finished consumer products. The company sources raw materials including cocoa, dairy, wheat, edible oils, sugar, nuts, and packaging materials from global suppliers. It manufactures products in owned and leased facilities, then distributes through direct store delivery, company-owned warehouses, distribution centers, third-party distributors, and increasingly through digital commerce channels. The company is positioned in the midstream to downstream segments of the food supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's four strategic priorities are: (1) accelerating consumer-centric growth through multi-category expansion and high-growth channels; (2) driving operational excellence via supply chain optimization and digital transformation; (3) building a winning growth culture through diversity, agility, and local empowerment; and (4) scaling sustainable snacking with focus on sustainable sourcing, environmental impact reduction, and mindful snacking innovation. R&D initiatives emphasize consumer-centric product development, sustainability, reduced-sugar and plant-based options, and leveraging SnackFutures innovation hub for emerging opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Mondelēz generates revenue primarily through product sales of chocolate, biscuits, baked snacks, gum & candy, beverages, and cheese & grocery products sold to retail customers and directly to consumers. The company employs a multi-channel distribution model including traditional retail, e-commerce, direct-to-consumer platforms, and social media sales. Revenue is generated through wholesale distribution to retailers and foodservice operators, as well as direct consumer sales through digital platforms. In 2022, net revenues were $31.5 billion with organic net revenue growth of 12.3%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mondelēz competes in a highly competitive global snacking industry against global, regional, and local competitors including food, snack and beverage companies. The company's performance peer group includes Campbell Soup, Coca-Cola, Colgate-Palmolive, Danone, General Mills, Hershey, Kellogg, Kraft Heinz, Nestlé, PepsiCo, Procter & Gamble, and Unilever. The company positions itself as a global leader in snacking with advantaged market positions across most product categories, supported by iconic global and local brands, strong distribution networks, and marketing capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Mondelēz is one of the world's largest snack companies with 2022 net revenues of $31.5 billion and net earnings of $2.7 billion. The company is a large accelerated filer with approximately 1.36 billion shares outstanding as of January 31, 2023, and a market capitalization of approximately $85.1 billion as of June 30, 2022. Net revenues increased 9.7% in 2022 and 8.0% in 2021, with organic net revenue growth of 12.3% in 2022 and 5.1% in 2021. Diluted EPS was $1.96 in 2022 and $3.04 in 2021, with Adjusted EPS of $2.95 in 2022 and $2.85 in 2021.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mondelēz differentiates through a portfolio of iconic global and local brands including Oreo, Ritz, LU, CLIF Bar, Tate's, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, and Toblerone. The company emphasizes quality, taste, innovation, and consumer-centric product development. Key differentiators include: strong brand recognition and loyalty, product innovation addressing evolving consumer preferences (reduced sugar, plant-based options), sustainability initiatives (sustainable sourcing, reduced packaging waste), extensive distribution networks, digital commerce capabilities, and local market responsiveness. The company's purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack for the right moment, made the right way with sustainable ingredients and packaging.
